provider_failure_policy.quality_call_failure: record ESCALATE_SYSTEM_FAILURE with explicit provider failure provenance
provider_failure_policy.compatibility_failure_before_first_score: abort without opening development performance results

operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.citation_completeness_applicability: Only queries whose registered expected decision is ANSWER_WITH_EVIDENCE have applicable citation completeness. Correct clarification and escalation control responses are citation-free and receive citation_completeness=null.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.sentence_segmentation: Split on whitespace following terminal punctuation . ! ? after trimming; retain inline citations with their sentence.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.factual_sentence_rule: A segmented sentence is factual if the candidate decision is ANSWER_WITH_EVIDENCE, or the sentence contains an inline document citation, or it contains the token HelixBank. Otherwise clarification/escalation control language is treated as non-factual.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.G0_conflict_detection: Detect the literal controlled conflict fixture sentence in candidate-visible evidence text; do not inspect hidden conflict_fixture labels.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.G0_ambiguity_detection: Detect the literal phrase 'not specific enough' in candidate-visible query text.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.G0_missing_evidence_detection: Empty direct-evidence pack maps to ESCALATE_LOW_CONFIDENCE.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.G0_answer_template: For remaining answerable cases, quote the first governing policy sentence beginning 'Requests are handled by' and append all presented eligible evidence citations in document_id order.
operational_interpretations_frozen_befor.adversarial_development_only: Apply every registered transformation type only to development intents in A4.2. Do not generate adversarial variants from confirmatory intents.

inference.method: paired nonparametric cluster bootstrap by intent
